name: verdigris-protocol
title: Verdigris Protocol
summary: A first person horror shooter against an alien growth on a space station.
description:
The alien isn't aboard Marigold Station. It's growing through it.

You're the night shift engineer on a farming station where something
came up through the soil in Hydroponics. Now a red, wet growth called
the Bloom spreads through the decks, room by room, taking the crew as
it goes. Burn it back with a plasma cutter, cut the power it feeds on,
seal doors, light flares, and dig out the Heart that roots each deck.

- Eight decks round a ring, each with its own creatures, weapons and
  a reason to save it; the ones you leave are lost to the Bloom
- The growth spreads in real time: through open doors, along power
  lines, into the dark
- Gore, dismemberment and a Gore setting (Full, Less or Off) that can
  be locked with a code
- Comfort settings: no head bob or view roll by default
- Shift mode: a new station every night, with online boards
- Plays fully offline, with a keyboard and mouse or a controller
